title: In vitro 3D full-thickness skin equivalent model with collagen I
author: Tham, Lim, et al.

steps.title: Prepare stock media and feeder cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reagents: (1) stock human keratinocyte medium, (2) culture media for mouse 3T3‑J2 fibroblasts, human fibroblasts, and human keratinocytes (see Materials), and (3) irradiated 3T3‑J2 feeder cells for 2D keratinocyte cultures. Keep all media at the appropriate temperature before use.

steps.title: Expand human fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Thaw a cryovial of human fibroblasts in a 37 °C water bath, add to 10 mL pre‑warmed fibroblast medium, spin 1000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL pre‑warmed medium. Seed 0.5–1 × 10⁶ cells into a T75 flask containing 12 mL pre‑warmed fibroblast medium. Change medium every 2 days and never allow cells to become confluent for more than one day. When sufficient numbers are reached, detach with 5 mL 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA in a humidified 5 % CO₂, 37 °C incubator for 5–10 min, neutralize with 5 mL pre‑warmed medium, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend in pre‑warmed medium. Expand to the desired cell quantity.

steps.title: Expand human keratinocytes
steps.instruction: Day 1: Thaw irradiated 3T3‑J2 cells in a 37 °C water bath, add to 10 mL pre‑warmed 3T3‑J2 medium, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL pre‑warmed 3T3‑J2 medium. Seed 0.4 × 10⁶ cells into a 10‑cm dish with 10 mL pre‑warmed 3T3‑J2 medium. Day 2: Thaw human keratinocytes in a 37 °C water bath, add to 10 mL pre‑warmed keratinocyte medium, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL pre‑warmed keratinocyte medium. Seed 0.5–1 × 10⁶ keratinocytes into the same 10‑cm dish (now containing the feeder cells) with 10 mL pre‑warmed keratinocyte medium. Change medium every 2 days and avoid >1 day confluence. When ready for 3D seeding, detach with 5 mL 0.1 % Trypsin‑EDTA in a humidified 5 % CO₂, 37 °C incubator for 5–10 min, filter the suspension through a 40‑µm strainer to remove feeder cells and differentiated keratinocytes, neutralize with 10 mL pre‑warmed keratinocyte medium, spin 1000 rpm 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL pre‑warmed keratinocyte medium. Expand to the required cell number (≈5 × 10⁶ cells per confluent 10‑cm dish).

steps.title: Place culture inserts
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, place the 6‑well or 12‑well culture inserts into the corresponding wells of a deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare acellular matrix
steps.instruction: Keep all reagents on ice. For each 6‑well insert add 1 mL collagen‑I mixture; for each 12‑well insert add 250 µL chitosan‑collagen‑I mixture. Prepare the collagen‑I mixture on ice by adding, in order, sterile water (to 1 mL total), 0.1 mL 10 X reconstitution buffer, 0.1 mL 10 X DMEM, the required volume of rat‑tail collagen I (4 mg/mL, batch‑dependent), and then add 1 N NaOH dropwise (≈14 µL per 1 mL) until the solution shows a faint red colour (pH ~7.4). Swirl gently after each addition. Allow the mixture to sit on ice for a few minutes so that any bubbles rise; avoid introducing bubbles when pipetting. For the 12‑well chitosan‑collagen‑I mixture use the same base reagents plus 20 mg/mL chitosan (2.5 mg in 0.125 mL) and adjust NaOH similarly. Upscale the recipe proportionally for multiple inserts.

steps.title: Polymerize acellular matrix
steps.instruction: Gently tilt and rotate each 6‑well insert to spread the collagen‑I mixture evenly (not required for 12‑well inserts). Incubate the plates in a humidified 5 % CO₂, 37 °C incubator for 30 min (maximum 60 min) to allow gelation.

steps.title: Cast collagen‑fibroblast layer
steps.instruction: Prepare the collagen‑fibroblast mixture on ice: combine sterile water, 0.2 mL 10 X reconstitution buffer, 0.2 mL 10 X DMEM, resuspend the required pellet of human fibroblasts (0.75 × 10⁶ cells per 6‑well insert; 0.1875 × 10⁶ cells per 12‑well insert) in this solution, add rat‑tail collagen I (4 mg/mL, batch‑dependent), and adjust pH with 1 N NaOH as above (do NOT resuspend the pellet with water alone). Add 2 mL of this mixture to each 6‑well insert and 500 µL to each 12‑well insert. Tilt and rotate the 6‑well inserts (not needed for 12‑well) and incubate again at 5 % CO₂, 37 °C for 30 min (max 60 min).

steps.title: Add fibroblast culture medium
steps.instruction: Add pre‑warmed human fibroblast culture medium to each insert and its underlying deep well: 6‑well – 6 mL into the insert and 10 mL into the deep well; 12‑well – 500 µL into the insert and 5 mL into the deep well. Avoid generating bubbles beneath the insert membrane.

steps.title: Incubate dermal layer overnight
steps.instruction: Place the plates in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂ at 37 °C and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Seed keratinocytes onto dermal layer
steps.instruction: Aspirate the fibroblast medium from each insert and deep well carefully without touching the 3‑D dermal equivalent. Add human keratinocyte medium onto the dermal layer: 1 mL for 6‑well inserts, 100 µL for 12‑well inserts. Immediately seed keratinocytes in the same medium: 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL for 6‑well, 0.25 × 10⁶ cells in 100 µL for 12‑well. Gently shake the plates horizontally to spread cells evenly.

steps.title: Initial keratinocyte attachment
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 5 % CO₂, 37 °C for 30 min. During this period, gently shake side‑to‑side every 5–10 min (avoid orbital shaking) to promote uniform cell distribution.

steps.title: Add additional keratinocyte medium
steps.instruction: Add fresh keratinocyte medium gently: 4 mL into each 6‑well insert and 10 mL into its deep well; 300 µL into each 12‑well insert and 5 mL into its deep well. Avoid creating bubbles beneath the insert membrane.

steps.title: Incubate epidermal layer overnight
steps.instruction: Place the plates back into a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂ at 37 °C and incubate overnight to allow epidermal stratification.
